## Checklist

See CONTRIBUTING.md for each item.

- [ ] Commit messages use `scope: description`, with the reason in the body.
- [ ] Every new factual claim has a source and the date it was checked; unconfirmed claims carry ⚠ and a check in `docs/ROADMAP.md`.
- [ ] No confidential terms from companies, contact details, key material, or personal or machine-specific details.
- [ ] Changes the recommendation, a decision, or a fusing, flashing or key procedure? Say so here; a person reviews it.
- [ ] Needs a matching change in another FoxieOS repository? Link its pull request here.
